content.short: Tonation is a social protocol on TON that integrates financial tips and donations into social interactions.
content.description: Tonation is an innovative social protocol and platform built on the TON blockchain that seamlessly merges social media engagement with decentralized finance. It allows users to send and receive Toncoin 'donations' or tips directly through social interactions, empowering creators and rewarding community members for their contributions. Tonation aims to create a more equitable social economy where value is shared directly between users without intermediaries, leveraging the speed and low costs of the TON network to facilitate micro-transactions globally.
content.meta: Monetize your social presence with Tonation on TON. Financial tipping for social media on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
